summary.plain: A new, larger version of the proton trap and neutron counter that will trap about a hundred times more decay protons than the previous apparatus.
summary.technical: Larger superconducting magnet and proton trap, larger neutron beam, segmented silicon proton detector, improved neutron flux monitor and upgraded alpha-gamma device for absolute flux calibration.

technology.quote: BL3 will employ a larger magnet and proton trap, larger neutron beam, and segmented silicon detector
technology.value: Larger magnet and proton trap, larger neutron beam and segmented silicon detector
